mainEntity.name: How much does Website Entity Optimization for GEO cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Website Entity Optimization for GEO varies significantly based on the complexity of your business, the number of locations, the competitiveness of your target markets, and the scope of services required. Factors influencing pricing include the initial audit, creation of location-specific content, Google Business Profile management, schema markup implementation, and ongoing monitoring and reporting. Generally, pricing can range from a monthly retainer for comprehensive services to project-based fees for specific optimization tasks. A detailed proposal is provided after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of GEO optimization varies based on business complexity, number of locations, market competition, and service scope, typically ranging from monthly retainers to project-based fees.
